docs.title: Free-threaded CPython in Python 3.13
docs.content:
Python 3.13 ships an experimental free-threaded build that runs without the global interpreter lock.

It is not the default build. You must choose it when installing or compiling.

docs.title: Experimental JIT compiler
docs.content: Python 3.13 adds an experimental just-in-time compiler. It is off by default and is switched on at build time with a configure flag.

docs.title: The new interactive REPL
docs.content: The interactive interpreter in Python 3.13 is based on code from PyPy. It supports multiline editing and colored prompts.

docs.title: Python 3.13.0 release
docs.content: Python 3.13.0 was released on October 7, 2024. It is the latest feature release of the language.

docs.title: Python 3.12 release notes
docs.content: Python 3.12 was released in October 2023 and improved error messages.
